template_data.headline_html: Enter federal contracting without past performance.

items.title: Match the prime's NAICS code
items.desc: Bring capacity or a clearance they lack. Your contract history is not the value here.

items.title: Use mentor-protégé programs
items.desc: SBA and DoD run structured arrangements that include guaranteed subcontract work.

items.title: Get the agreement in writing first
items.desc: Teaming agreements must be signed before the bid — verbal handshakes vanish at award.

items.title: Define the work share as a number
items.desc: Vague percentages become disputes. Lock in the split before you submit.
